mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1200 units, indicating robust demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of instances when HOUST > 1200, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) falls below 5%, indicating a tight labor market, wage pressures increase, driving inflation expectations and, consequently, positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to expected monetary policy responses.
failure_condition: SPX returns over 60d are not significantly correlated with UNRATE < 5% instances (Pearson's r < 0.1), or walk-forward IC < 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average, signaling supply chain resilience, predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as manufacturers' profitability improves.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher in triggered instances (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: The joint behavior of rising housing starts (HOUST) and increasing retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broadening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as consumer and housing sectors align.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 35% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are rising, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with an increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL), indicating managed inflation, predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as real interest rates decrease.
regime_hint: monetary easing cycle with inflation management
failure_condition: Walk-forward IC < 0.025 over any 2-year rolling window, or the predicted relationship does not hold in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 200,000 in a month, signaling labor market strength, and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 6%, the S&P 500 is expected to produce positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to the anticipated economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX returns over 60d are not significantly correlated with triggered instances (Pearson's r < 0.12), or walk-forward IC < 0.018.

mechanism_narrative: A GDP (GDPC1) growth rate above 3% on a quarterly basis, indicating strong aggregate demand, predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic activity broadens.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher in triggered instances (t-test p > 0.15).
